'''Hangar Hunters''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] organization active around the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Operating out of an ancient flight [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] which laid in ruins, the gang accepted the bounty placed upon a rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
